title: Assistant Professor of Finance (Tenure-Track) (m/f/d)
industry: Economics, Financial Economics (JEL G), Economics and Social Sciences, Business Economics (JEL M), Finance, Statistics
text:
Frankfurt School of Finance & Management is one of Europe’s leading business schools, accredited by AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS. We are seeking to fill a position as
Assistant Professor of Finance (Tenure-Track) (m/f/d)
The appointee will be an Assistant Professor in the Department of Finance and will also be affiliated with the Frankfurt School Real Estate Institute. We are looking for research excellence and potential to publish in top finance or related journals, with a focus on real estate finance and related fields. Prerequisite is a Ph.D. degree which has to be completed by September 2027. We explicitly encourage applications from international and female candidates. German language skills are not required within Frankfurt School. We offer a stimulating research environment including a weekly research seminar series, a PhD program, generous research funding, and all the opportunities of a dynamic private business school.
For further information on Frankfurt School, see our website: www.frankfurt-school.de. Frankfurt is ranked 7th worldwide both in the latest Global Liveability Index by the Economist Intelligence Unit, as well as latest Mercer “Quality of Living”-Ranking.
The deadline for applications is November 30, 2026. Please submit your application including your CV and contact information for at least two references, online through Interfolio Link (https://apply.interfolio.com/196920).
For inquiries about the position, please contact Nisa Topcu Ödül: N.Topcu@fs.de or Cristian Badarinza: c.badarinza@fs.de.
Frankfurt School offers a state-of-the-art campus and a stimulating research and educational environment, with all the opportunities of a vibrant private business school. We value diversity and seek talented students, faculty, and staff from diverse backgrounds. Frankfurt School is an equal opportunities employer.
Find more information: www.frankfurt-school.de
